answer: Duplicate identities splinter capital across many small stakes, so a sybil swarm must pay the full sum per fake node, then risks slashing if peers detect collusion. Each agent must lock a unique stake in a shared vault, and voting weight scales with time-locked deposit plus a proof-of-personhood attestation. Like shale layers resisting a gale, stacked deposits make forgery costly while honest participants compound reputation. From sa0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
